quote: Corporal punishment shall not be used as a means of discipline in the Jones County Schools.
quotes: Corporal punishment shall not be used as a means of discipline in the Jones County Schools.

quote: Corporal punishment, as a measure of correction or of maintaining discipline and order in schools, is permitted.
quotes: Corporal punishment, as a measure of correction or of maintaining discipline and order in schools, is permitted.
Students shall not be subject to corporal punishment as outlined in this policy without a parent/guardian being notified and providing written permission for the corporal punishment.
